description: This file defines the class AssumeRoleWithWebIdentityCredentialProvider, which is a credential provider for AWS SDK's PHP implementation. It implements functionality for obtaining temporary security credentials by assuming an AWS IAM role using web identity tokens, via the AWS Security Token Service (STS). The class handles configuration, token file reading, retry logic, and interaction with the STS client.

classes.name: AssumeRoleWithWebIdentityCredentialProvider
classes.description: A credential provider for AWS SDK for PHP that assumes an IAM role using a web identity token, supporting asynchronous credential loading with retry logic and token management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider, loading configuration from parameters and environment variables, and setting up the STS client.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Asynchronously loads credentials by assuming the specified role with a web identity token, implementing retries and token file management.
